text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm, the Track Landscaping 
Division...! I knew they existed, but 
hearing about it is so fascinating!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Right? They keep the racetrack nice and 
clean for us on weekdays and race days 
alike!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
They're aiming to create a racetrack 
that's safe for both Umamusume and humans! 
Being able to see things from both 
perspectives is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
And on race day! They decorate this 
once-in-a-lifetime grand stage with 
flowers... Oh! They even design the finish 
line post, too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! So racecourses are works of art 
filled with the burning passion of the 
groundskeeping crew, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thinking through how best to present it, 
and the moment everyone lays eyes on it— 
that sense of pride! I think I understand 
it!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Totally! If pretty flowers make everyone 
smile, that'd make us super happy too, 
wouldn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to bring joy to so many people, 
and cheering on the girls running in the 
race...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe she's comforting the girls 
crying over their races with flowers too!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah!! Blast-chan! That interpretation 
is the absolute best!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Witnessing glory and tears from behind the 
flowers, the groundskeeping department... 
Another untold story of the races...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alriiiight! I can draw it! Blast-chan! Let 
me interview the track landscaping crew!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Oho! I'll go ask 'em! Heheh, looks like 
another one of Boo's acquaintances is 
gonna end up in a manga~♪
